verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only general marketing pages about DLSS/AI features and CUDA developer tools, not a documented public API for programmatically driving the GPU's features; explicit probes for OpenAPI/swagger specs and machine-readable docs (docs.md) all returned 404s, and only a generic developer-portal llms.txt was found. There is no evidence of an agent-drivable API surface for GeForce RTX 5070 Ti.
